title: Capstone: un pipeline de producción defendido

checks.description: worker/ está en tablero con su uv.lock, su Dockerfile y sus tests unitarios y de integración
checks.cmd: ls worker/uv.lock worker/Dockerfile worker/src/tablero_worker/purge.py worker/tests/unit worker/tests/integration >/dev/null

checks.description: ci-worker.yml no tiene steps propios: su único job llama a _python.yml del repo central por SHA, con integración
checks.cmd: yq '[(.on | keys | sort | join(",")), (.jobs | length), (.jobs[] | (has("steps"), (.uses | test("/actions-tablero/\.github/workflows/_python\.yml@[0-9a-f]{40}$")), .with."working-directory", .with.package, .with.integration))] | join(" ")' .github/workflows/ci-worker.yml
checks.assert: stdout~^workflow_call,workflow_dispatch 1 false true worker tablero_worker true$

checks.description: scripts/changed-areas.sh marca worker si cambia worker/ o api/migrations/, y no si solo cambia web/
checks.cmd: s=$PWD/scripts/changed-areas.sh; d=$(mktemp -d) && cd "$d" && export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=ci GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=ci@example.invalid GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=ci GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=ci@example.invalid && git init -q && git commit -q --allow-empty -m base && mkdir -p api/migrations web && touch api/migrations/002_x.sql && git add . && git commit -qm m && a=$("$s" HEAD~1 | grep ^worker=) && touch web/a.ts && git add . && git commit -qm w && echo "$a $("$s" HEAD~1 | grep ^worker=)"

checks.description: ci.yml llama a ci-worker.yml cuando el área worker cambia y ci-gate lo espera
checks.cmd: yq '"output=" + (.jobs.changes.outputs | has("worker") | tostring) + " uses=" + .jobs.worker.uses + " if=" + .jobs.worker.if + " gate=" + (.jobs."ci-gate".needs | contains(["worker"]) | tostring)' .github/workflows/ci.yml

checks.description: worker/Dockerfile trae su imagen base y uv fijadas por digest
images.yml construye tablero-worker con _image.yml del repo central y lo resume con los otros dos digests
release.yml publica, escanea y firma tablero-worker en la misma matriz que api y web
Dependabot vigila el uv.lock y el Dockerfile de worker/
checks.cmd: yq '[.updates[] | select(."package-ecosystem" == "uv" or ."package-ecosystem" == "docker") | ."package-ecosystem" + "=" + ((.directories // [.directory]) | contains(["/worker"]) | tostring)] | join(" ")' .github/dependabot.yml

checks.description: scripts/audit-workflows.sh detecta cada regla de la política en un repo de prueba y sale con 1
checks.cmd:
d=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$d/.github/workflows"; printf 'on: push
jobs:
  a:
    runs-on: [ubuntu-latest]
    permissions: write-all
    container: node:26
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ./local
  b:
    uses: o/r/.github/workflows/x.yml@main
' > "$d/.github/workflows/bad.yml"; printf 'FROM python:3.15 AS build
COPY --from=ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:0.13.6 /uv /uv
FROM build
COPY --from=build /a /a
' > "$d/Dockerfile"; { scripts/audit-workflows.sh "$d"; echo "rc=$?"; } | awk -F': ' 'NF>=3{n[$2]++} /^rc=/{rc=$0} END{printf "%s image-digest=%d permissions-root=%d write-all=%d timeout=%d runner-latest=%d unpinned-uses=%d", rc, n["image-digest"], n["permissions-root"], n["write-all"], n["timeout"], n["runner-latest"], n["unpinned-uses"]}'
checks.assert: stdout~^rc=1 image-digest=3 permissions-root=1 write-all=1 timeout=1 runner-latest=1 unpinned-uses=2$

checks.description: scripts/audit-workflows.sh no encuentra nada en tablero
lint-workflows.yml pasa scripts/audit-workflows.sh en cada cambio de workflows
La release v1.1.0 de actions-tablero pasa la auditoría sin hallazgos
checks.cmd: owner=${GH_REPO%%/*}; d=$(mktemp -d); gh repo clone "$owner/actions-tablero" "$d" -- -q --depth 1 --branch v1.1.0 && scripts/audit-workflows.sh "$d" | tail -1

checks.description: Todas las referencias de tablero al repo central apuntan al commit de v1.1.0
checks.cmd: owner=${GH_REPO%%/*}; have=$(grep -rhoE 'actions-tablero/[^@ ]+@[0-9a-f]{40}' .github | sed 's/.*@//' | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '); want=$(gh api "repos/$owner/actions-tablero/commits/v1.1.0" --jq .sha); [[ "$have" == "$want " ]] && echo v1.1.0 || echo "$have"

checks.description: Todos los workflows pasan actionlint y zizmor sin hallazgos
El último commit de main pasó un ci completo lanzado a mano, con los tres jobs del worker en verde
checks.cmd: git fetch -q origin main && id=$(gh run list --workflow ci.yml --event workflow_dispatch --commit "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" --json databaseId,conclusion --jq '[.[] | select(.conclusion == "success")][0].databaseId') && gh run view "$id" --json jobs --jq '[.jobs[] | select(.name | startswith("worker /")) | .conclusion] | "\(length) \(unique | join(","))"'

checks.description: tablero-worker de la última release tiene attestations de procedencia y de SBOM firmadas por release.yml
checks.cmd: owner=${GH_REPO%%/*}; v=$(gh release view --json tagName --jq .tagName); img="oci://ghcr.io/${owner,,}/tablero-worker:${v#v}"; for p in https://slsa.dev/provenance/v1 https://spdx.dev/Document/v2.3; do gh attestation verify "$img" --repo "$GH_REPO" --signer-workflow "$GH_REPO/.github/workflows/release.yml" --predicate-type "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 && printf 'ok ' || printf 'mal '; done

checks.description: docs/pipeline.md tiene las cinco secciones de la defensa y enlaza al menos tres runs como evidencia
checks.cmd: f=docs/pipeline.md; printf 'secciones=%s runs=%s' "$(grep -cE '^## (Mapa del pipeline|Modelo de amenazas|Decisiones|Riesgos aceptados|Evidencias)$' $f)" "$(grep -oE 'https://github\.com/[^/]+/tablero/actions/runs/[0-9]+' $f | sort -u | wc -l)"
